INSERT INTO BILL_CLOSE_USER_LIST ( LEGACY_USER_ID, BILL_CLOSE_MONTH, CLOSE_TYPE, SEQ, KEP_DEPT, BUYER_CODE, AGENT_CODE, CLOSE_CMPL_YN ) SELECT X.LEGACY_USER_ID, X.BILL_CLOSE_MONTH, X.CLOSE_TYPE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY X.LEGACY_USER_ID, X.BILL_CLOSE_MONTH, X.CLOSE_TYPE ORDER BY X.KEP_DEPT, X.BILL_CLOSE_MONTH, X.CLOSE_TYPE ) AS SEQ, X.KEP_DEPT, X.BUYER_CODE, X.AGENT_CODE AS AGENT_CODE, 'Y' AS CLOSE_CMPL_YN FROM ( SELECT (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id}) AS LEGACY_USER_ID, #{CLOSE_MONTH} AS BILL_CLOSE_MONTH, #{close_type} AS CLOSE_TYPE, AR.DEPT_CODE AS KEP_DEPT, AR.BUYER_CODE AS BUYER_CODE, AR.AGENT_CODE AS AGENT_CODE FROM KEPTARDT AR WHERE AR.STATUS <> 'D' AND AR.AR_CLOSE_MONTH = #{CLOSE_MONTH} AND AR.ADD_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM ICOMGRDT GR WHERE AR.BUYER_CODE = GR.BUYER
AND AR.TAX_BILL_NO = GR.AR_TAX_BILL_NO
AND AR.TAX_BILL_NO = GR.LOGIS_TAX_BILL_NO
AND GR.STATUS <> 'D' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM BILL_CLOSE_USER_LIST B WHERE 1=1
AND AR.BUYER_CODE = B.BUYER_CODE
AND AR.AGENT_CODE = B.AGENT_CODE
AND AR.AR_CLOSE_MONTH = B.BILL_CLOSE_MONTH AND (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = AR.ADD_USER_ID) = B.LEGACY_USER_ID AND DECODE(AR.AR_TYPE, '01','AR','LG') = B.CLOSE_TYPE )
) X GROUP BY X.LEGACY_USER_ID, X.BILL_CLOSE_MONTH, X.CLOSE_TYPE, X.KEP_DEPT, X.BUYER_CODE, X.AGENT_CODE
